request: Our nightly backup has produced no archive since 3 September, but cron says the job runs every night and exits 0. Is cron broken, is the disk full, or is it something else?
known_answer: A run crashed on 3 September and left /var/run/backup.lock behind; backup.sh exits 0 whenever that lock file exists, so every later run skips silently. Removing the stale lock fixes it.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client

files.backup.sh:
#!/bin/sh
if [ -f /var/run/backup.lock ]; then exit 0; fi
touch /var/run/backup.lock
tar czf /backups/$(date +%F).tgz /srv/data
rm /var/run/backup.lock
